'''Qingbo Positioning Kit T1''' is a {{gear|5|Kit}}gear item.

{{Item description|Designed by Endfield after referencing wildland handcrafting techniques, and assembled by the AIC. This equipment improves the wearer's combat capabilities.|Very economic equipment, created according to ancient scrolls and books found in Qingbo Stockade.
A simple device that integrates the functions of aquifer dowsers and magnetic compasses. According to records, this gadget achieved great deeds during the early years of Qingbo Stockade.}}
